about: Stop 2 for one term sheet. The phone and the dashboard post the same request; the borrower agent on the node then signs the same approval payload.

cost_lines: You repay 605.92 USDT by day 30. No other fees.
If BTC falls and the loan is liquidated early, the lender still receives the full term's interest; on this 30-day loan that is 5.92 USDT, about 0.99% of the amount borrowed.

render.title: Borrow 600.00 USDT against 0.01211840 BTC
lines: You receive 600.00 USDT (test USDT on regtest).
You repay 605.92 USDT by day 30. No other fees.
If BTC falls and the loan is liquidated early, the lender still receives the full term's interest; on this 30-day loan that is 5.92 USDT, about 0.99% of the amount borrowed.
Term: 30 blocks, until block 530 (1 block per day). Interest 5.92 USDT at 12.00% APR, ACT/365.
Collateral: 0.01211840 BTC locked in a Taproot escrow at 50.00% loan-to-value (BTC at $100,000).
if_price_falls: If BTC falls to $71,429 (70.00% LTV), a margin call gives you 10 blocks to add collateral or repay.

At $62,500 (80.00% LTV) after the cure window, the lender and the platform can liquidate: the lender takes exactly what is owed (605.92 USDT) in bitcoin at the oracle price and the rest returns to the borrower. No penalty; the only cost is the mining fee.
if_not_repaid: After block 530 plus 5 blocks of grace, an unpaid loan defaults and the lender can claim the collateral with the platform.
If nobody acts, the borrower can recover the collateral alone from block 555.
render.settlement: Repayment: over RGB, then the lender co-signs the release. If the lender refuses, the platform can co-sign instead.
render.scorer: Credit check: in-process, dev-inprocess trust, recommendation QUALIFY. Evidence: sandbox run record 565656565656…, bound to this loan on Bitcoin. No hardware attestation.
render.final: Approving signs this exact term sheet. Once the collateral is locked, this can’t be undone.

waiting.explanation: If you do not repay by the due block plus grace, the lender takes what is owed in bitcoin and the rest comes back to you.
